page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 93.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.88 GB per core. For hardware acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA T4 GPU from the Turing architecture family, which is bundled with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not included on this instance, and network connectivity is rated at an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance split between CPU-bound tasks and GPU-accelerated workloads. Single-core CPU performance is weak, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests, with single-threaded gzip compression performing in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by PassMark and Geekbench multi-core scores. The standout capability of this instance lies in its GPU-driven LLM inference, where prompt processing speeds for both small (135M) and medium (7B) models rank in the top tier (top 10%), and text generation for medium models is strong.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge offers a specialized resource profile that trades off high-speed single-core CPU performance for cost-effective GPU acceleration. The inclusion of the NVIDIA T4 GPU makes it highly efficient for parallel processing workloads compared to CPU-only instances, though the lack of local storage requires external network-attached storage solutions.

This instance is highly suited for workloads such as low-to-medium complexity LLM inference, machine learning model deployment, and parallel graphics processing like ray tracing. It is also applicable for general-purpose multi-threaded applications, database operations, and static web serving, though it is not recommended for single-threaded, CPU-intensive tasks.
